class.name: GDeflateCompressor
class.brief_description: Compresses byte arrays using the GDeflate tile format.
class.description: [GDeflateCompressor] produces data compatible with [GDeflateDecompressor] and the DirectStorage GDeflate request path. Compression levels range from [code]1[/code] through [code]12[/code]. The default [member compression_level] is [code]1[/code].

method.name: compress
method.description: Compresses [param input]. An invalid [param level], including [code]-1[/code], uses [member compression_level]. Returns an empty array for empty input or compression failure.

method.name: compress_bound
method.description: Returns an upper bound for the compressed size of an input with [param input_size] bytes. Returns [code]0[/code] for non-positive sizes.

method.name: compress_with_stats
method.description: Compresses [param data] with GDeflate and returns a [Dictionary] containing compression telemetry: [code]compressed_data[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]original_size[/code] ([int]), [code]compressed_size[/code] ([int]), [code]compression_ratio[/code] ([float]), and [code]success[/code] ([bool]).

method.name: get_compression_level
method.description: Returns the default compression level used when [method compress] receives an invalid level.

method.name: set_compression_level
method.description: Sets the default compression level, clamped to the range [code]1[/code] through [code]12[/code].

method.name: verify_round_trip
method.description: Compresses and immediately decompresses [param data] in memory to verify that the compression and decompression round-trip produces bit-identical output. Returns [code]true[/code] if the round-trip succeeds.

members.member: Default GDeflate compression level, from [code]1[/code] through [code]12[/code].
